raw:
@q query
  mode exists
  where all
    match
      relation "report to"
      role subject ?x
      role object "Paloma"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be based in"
      role subject ?x
      role location "Timișoara"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
